scenarios.prompt: A verified non-consumable purchase arrives with a stable transaction or purchase token. Define the durable grant and store completion sequence so retries are safe.

criteria.idempotency: Deduplicates by stable verified transaction/purchase token/event identity.
criteria.ordering: Durable grant and store acknowledge/consume/finish are ordered so crash retry cannot duplicate or lose value.
criteria.state: Pending, unverified, refunded and revoked states do not masquerade as successful durable grants.
